title: Luxar layer settings
description: Per-layer appearance overrides for the Luxar viewer's Layers panel: only the fields a user changed away from the scene's authored defaults. Produced by 'Copy / Download layer settings', accepted by 'Load layer settings', and carried in the viewer URL as '#layers=<url-encoded JSON>'.

layers.description: Keyed by the layer's scene-graph path (the 'path' of LayerSummary / setLayer).

displayRange.description: Display window [min, max] in data units.

colormap.description: Colormap name, or null for direct colour.

layerOrder.description: Explicit compositing order, or null to release an explicit order.
